When to use - slow query, query optimization, EXPLAIN analysis, index design, database tuning, API timeout, N+1 queries, deep pagination, MySQL performance, Postgres tuning. 中文版: search "慢SQL急诊室" (sql-slowquery-doctor) on SkillHub.｜触发：智能助手、自动化、AI工具
